editorial:
Imagine the world's greatest thief going head-to-head with a trio of high-tech sisters who are just as sneaky as he is. That is exactly what you get here. You follow Lupin and his crew as they try to snag three special paintings, but the Kisugi sisters from Cat's Eye are after them too. The vibe is light, colorful, and full of energy. It feels like a giant game of cat and mouse where nobody really wants to lose, but everyone is having a blast while trying to outsmart each other. It is a perfect mix of heist action and silly comedy that keeps you smiling throughout.

You will love how the action moves quickly and the animation looks sharp and bright. The chemistry between the thieves is the best part, though some of the plot twists might feel a bit simple if you have seen a lot of heist movies. If you want a stress-free watch, this is for you. To get the best experience, you should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the detail. If you are a collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move so you can rewatch the funny bits anytime.
endingExplained: In the end, Lupin and the Cat's Eye sisters realize they have more in common than they thought. After a wild chase, they uncover the secret mystery behind the paintings and their father's past. Instead of one side winning everything, they reach a mutual respect. Lupin manages to pull off his signature trick, but the sisters get what they need. Everything wraps up with a funny chase as the police try and fail to catch them all.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves clever thieves and colorful animation.
